hypotheses.linearization: One-shot Jacobian predicts improvement not realized nonlinearly; shorter/trust-controlled relinearized steps improve same-head behavior.
hypotheses.memory_identification: Activation vs inactivation swaps isolate the regressing K_Pst direction; coefficient-equivalent corrections need not preserve recovery memory.
hypotheses.objective_support: Relaxation-window residuals improve actual offset gates beyond isolated crossing rows at equal fit residual count.
hypotheses.coverage: At matched maximum budget, broadened history/duration coverage improves unseen recovery and tails without new failed cases.
hypotheses.conditioning: Shallow-tail crossing amplifies tiny residuals; report residual/slope-predicted displacement alongside unchanged exact timing metrics.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.

coverage: One matched comparison window_iterative vs window_iterative_coverage. Same24 paths,512 residualrows/channel/seed,16384 geometryanchors,4iterationcap. Coverage package timewarps paths by.5/1/2 cyclically and replaces initial gate equilibria -95/-42 with-70/-35mV. Offline labels recomputed for quantized paths; inference unchanged. This tests combined duration/history coverage, not their separate effects. Report evaluations/candidates actually used, since backtracking may stop early.
